messages:
ina: Quick playtest summary — keyboard users lose cursor focus when hitting Stop; focus jumps to the action row and selection in the message is lost. Also the token counter briefly flashes a different color which looked like an error to testers. attached: screenshot and short screen recording https://img.redwood/mock/stop-focus.mp4 mike: thanks — can you repro steps? is it only on Safari/mobile or all browsers? ina: steps: 1) open playground 2) start streaming 3) use arrow keys to move caret in the response (for copy) 4) press Space on Stop button. On Chrome mac it moves focus to the button but doesn't restore caret to message after stop. devon: likely culprit: we call .focus() on the stop button when streaming starts to support keyboard Stop. but we don't return focus to the message container on stop. we can set focus back to the composed message region or to a read-only textarea that preserves caret. ellie: UX thought: we should surface a small toast after stopping that says "Streaming stopped — press R to regenerate, Enter to resume" so keyboard users have clear next actions. Also consider an inline keyboard shortcut hint next to Regenerate. :keyboard: content-bot: microcopy suggestion: replace "Stop" with "Stop streaming" (desktop) and add visually-hidden label for icon-only mobile buttons. For token counter tooltip: "Response tokens (generated by the model) — excludes prompt tokens and cached prefixes." mike: a11y detail: use aria-live="polite" on the final response container, but set aria-atomic="true" so screen readers read the whole final chunk once. Example snippet: ```html
Final response text
``` devon: perf/impl: also don't toggle a full CSS class that triggers layout on every token. Update innerText and a separate hidden meter for width. cache computed widths and only recalc on resize. will PR soon. ina: Token counter flash issue: looks like we animate color on every increment. Suggest subtle fade only when crossing thousands or other thresholds, not every token. Also include accessible change: expose token totals as a visually-hidden text for screen readers so they can query totals without watching the counter. ellie: Prompt library tweak: show token estimate badge and a small label "est." so it's clear. Add sort toggle "Lowest est. tokens" and a filter for "Recently used". Keep pin/favorite option. ui-bot: preview build for branch playground/stop-focus-fixes is up: https://preview.redwood/stop-focus-fixes (screenshots + accessibility report attached) :white_check_mark: ina: Acceptance checklist for devs/QA: - Keyboard: after Stop focus returns to response container and caret position is preserved or selection restored - Shortcuts: toast/hint shows R for regenerate and resumes use cached KV when possible - Screen reader: final state announced once (aria-atomic) and token totals exposed to SR users - Visual: token counter only animates on threshold changes; no red/orange flash that implies error - Prompt library: token estimate + last-used sort + pin action visible in card list mike: tagging @devon @ellie — please add to PR description and include small UX screenshots for keyboard flows. I'll run a quick a11y smoke after merge. :thumbsup:
